description: Counts incoming clock pulses 1 to 34 over and over, with eight outputs numbered 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21 and 34, each firing on the single count that matches its number

inputs.text: Each rise past 1.7V advances the count; the first pulse after a reset only measures the interval, and counting starts on the one after it
A rise past 1.7V sets the count back to the start; the next pulse after it measures the interval and counting resumes on the one after that

outputs.text: Fires at the count matching its own number, once per 34-count cycle, so every output fires at the same rate despite the panel's DIV numbering; it carries the CLOCK voltage, not the manual's 1.7V

notes: an output that has gone high falls again after half the last measured clock interval, so the pulse width follows the incoming clock
nothing comes out until a clock is patched to CLOCK, and the first pulse after the module is added or reset only measures the interval, so the outputs start on the second pulse
the lamp beside an output is lit while that output is high
the count is not written into the patch file, so it starts from the beginning each time the patch is loaded
